summary: Iteration 3 (frontend IA/UI refactor) full test. Backend: 47/47 pytest regression PASS unchanged (backend_test.py + test_iteration2.py). Frontend: Nav shows exactly Home/Shop/About via [data-testid^=nav-link-] (no Anime/Cars/Keychains/Coming Soon). Nav is transparent (rgba(10,10,10,0)) at scrollY=0 on home and turns glass (rgba(10,10,10,0.7) + blur) after scrolling. Legacy redirects verified: /collections -> /shop, /collections/anime -> /shop?type=posters&theme=anime, /collections/keychains -> /shop?type=keychains. Hero renders 'COLLECT WHAT YOU LOVE' (testid=hero-title). Shop hierarchical chips work: All/Posters/Keychains/T-Shirts (T-Shirts disabled). Posters reveals 7 theme sub-chips (Anime,Cars,Sports,Movies,Music,Gaming,Motivational). Keychains reveals 2 (Anime,Cars). URL updates with ?type=&theme= (uses replace history). Sort select present. Product cards enlarged, hover reveals Quick Add slide-up button — clicking add-to-cart-<slug> increments cart-count to 1 for logged-in demo user. Custom cursor dot+ring present under z 9998-9999, no CSS/console errors. Demo login (demo@paperandloop.com) redirects to /account. Admin login renders /admin with all 10 sidebar items (Dashboard, Orders, Products, Categories, Discounts, Customers, Analytics, Content, Activity, Settings) with zero JS errors. Mobile (375px): nav-mobile-toggle visible, tapping opens takeover with only 3 links Home/Shop/About. Zero console errors across all tested routes.

issues: Glass transition fires at scrollY>30 in Nav.jsx, not the ~50px stated in the request. Not a bug, just noting.
setParams uses {replace:true} — chip clicks do not push history entries, so browser Back does not step through prior filter states. Consider push on user-initiated chip clicks.

critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx cleanly implements the 3-link nav + glass-on-scroll animate; good use of framer-motion animate() for backgroundColor + backdropFilter.

Shop.jsx TAXONOMY constant well-structured; themeFor() heuristic is best-effort keyword bucketing — will misbucket products whose names lack the tokens (e.g. a 'Naruto' poster falls back to category_slug). Consider adding an explicit product.theme field to the product schema for correctness once the catalogue grows.
Shop.jsx uses setParams with {replace:true} on every chip change — user cannot Back through filter history.
CustomCursor rewrite with refs+rAF avoids per-move re-renders — no console errors observed during rapid movement.
Legacy /collections redirects work via <Navigate> and LegacyCollectionsRedirect component in App.js — clean approach.
